items.raw_excerpt: Bird strike caused a Qantas flight from Queenstown to be diverted to Christchurch on Saturday afternoon.
items.summary_en: A Qantas flight from Queenstown was diverted to Christchurch on Saturday afternoon after hitting a bird. The plane landed safely and no injuries were reported.

items.raw_excerpt: The Home Office has identified the former RAF base at Linton-on-Ouse as the site for an asylum camp.
items.summary_en: The UK Home Office has picked a former RAF base in Linton-on-Ouse as a new asylum camp. Local residents want the Asylum Minister to come see the village for himself. The decision has sparked concern among people living near the base.

items.raw_excerpt: When foreign parents send their children to German primary schools, they often come back with a whole new vocabulary of playground slang. Here's our guide to the main terms to know.
items.summary_en: Foreign parents in Germany often hear their kids using new playground words. This guide explains the most common German schoolyard slang terms. It helps parents understand what their children are really saying.

items.raw_excerpt: It’s not a public holiday, Constitution Day or the King's birthday, but Denmark’s flag is flown every September 5th from public buildings and buses across the country.
items.summary_en: Every September 5th, Denmark flies its flag from public buildings and buses. The day marks Flag Day, when the country honours its military and those who have served abroad. It is not a public holiday, but it has become a tradition across the nation.
items.summary_ko: 덴마크는 매년 9월 5일이 되면 공공건물과 버스에 국기를 게양한다. 이날은 국기의 날로, 해외에서 복무한 군인들을 기리는 날이다. 공휴일은 아니지만 전국적으로 자리 잡은 전통이 되었다.
items.title_en: Why Denmark Flies Its Flag on September 5th
items.title_original: Flag Day: Why does Denmark commemorate its military on September 5th?

items.raw_excerpt: Melissa Johns, 36, from Greater Manchester, says two weeks paternity leave is 'not enough' in 2026.
items.summary_en: Families in England say two weeks of paternity leave is not enough for new fathers. Melissa Johns, 36, from Greater Manchester, says dads need more time at home after a baby is born. The debate is growing in 2026 over how to better support new parents.
items.summary_ko: 영국의 한 가족이 아이가 태어난 뒤 아빠들에게 주어지는 2주간의 육아휴직이 너무 짧다고 목소리를 냈다. 그레이터맨체스터에 사는 멜리사 존스 씨는 아빠들이 집에 있을 시간이 더 필요하다고 말했다. 2026년 들어 새로운 부모를 더 잘 지원해야 한다는 논의가 커지고 있다.
items.title_en: Dads have to go back to work too soon after babies born, families say
